profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: Mt. Laurel, New Jersey, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Contribute to Reliability Engineering team responsible for developing and maintaining the software tools, applications and services that support Enterprise Technology Services(ETS)processes including the incident,problem,change and configuration management database for the ServiceNow platform critical for Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) business processes
-Develop,test and operate application software in a Linux environment utilize scripting languages (Python,node.js) JavaScript frameworks (AngularJS,jQuery,Bootstrap,ExtJS), and web services (RESTful /SOAP)Operate databases utilizing RDBMS technologies (MySQL/Oracle) and NoSQL technologies (MongoDB,CouchBase, Cassandra, Redis)
-Utilize network protocols (TCP/IP,UDPorSNMP)
-Ensure the consistent delivery of subscriber services by ensuring the accuracy of system,customer, location and business services data
 -Collaborate with project stakeholders to identify product and technical requirements
-Conduct analysis to determine integration needs and Design new software and web applications, support applications under development and customize current applications
-Assist with the software update process for existing applications and roll-outs of software releases
-Participate in training representatives and operations staff on internally-developed software applications
-Research,write,edit documentation and technical requirements,including software designs,evaluation plans,test results,technical manuals and formal recommendations and reports
-Monitor and evaluate competitive applications and products
-Review literature,patents, and current practices relevant to the solution of assigned projects
-Provide technical leadership throughout the design process and guidance with regard to practices,procedures and techniques
-Serve as a guide and mentor for junior-level software development engineer
-Work with the Quality Assurance team to determine if applications fit specification and technical requirements

positions.title: Senior Drupal Consultant
positions.description:
-Apply technical knowledge to update content and UI features of brand websites through a Drupal 7 Content Management System (CMS) and directly working with the UI code. 
-Works within organizational process to keep website content refreshed according to season.
-Add/Remove the product according to brand requirement. 
-Converts image design assets to an appropriate web format using Photoshop to be implemented on brand marketing websites through a Drupal 7 Content Management System(CMS). 
-Manage communication and feedback among marketing and consumer promotions managers for participating brands, the brand team, and the digital technologist team. 
-Assess inputs for completeness/appropriateness.
-Evaluates and analyses User Experience requirements for implementation approach. 
-Coordinate and communicate feedback to the digital agency and development team. 
-Configure the payment gateway using RESTful or SOAP API
-Provide QA testing to ensure all copy and image assets are implemented appropriately

positions.title: Team Lead- PHP/Drupal
positions.description:
-Developed the Web/Window Application by using scripting Language (PHP, Python) and Web Technology like CSS, HTML 5.0, XML, Ajax, VB.NET, ZOHO Creator, Drupal 7, Ubercart, civicrm, Joomla, and jQuery/JavaScript as front end and interact with SQL(MySQL) and No SQL as backend.
-Developing, testing and operating software that interacts with both SQL and NoSQL databases and uses network protocols.
-Responsible for all project communication including project status reporting.
-Responsible for coaching, developing and managing team members by assign task to team members, explain customer requirement, resolve technical related issues and train new developer.
-Developed and testing the software using scripting language (PHP) which execute automatically and dump the data from one SaaS (Software as a services) to another SaaS using RESTful or SOAP web service Application Programming interface(API)
-Experience developing, testing, and operating enterprise application software in a Linux environment utilizing at least one scripting language, JavaScript framework and either RESTful or SOAP web services.
-Report the daily progress of connectors development and explain the task to developers and get the work done from the team.

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Developing and testing the operating software by using scripting languages (PHP), and HTML, CSS, XHTML, XML, Ajax, and JavaScript Framework (jQuery) as front end and interact with SQL(MySQL) as back end.
-Resolve the production support ticket assigned by Team Leader or Senior Software Developer and update the full information related to ticket for further reference.
-Deliver the global Generic Reporting wizard that revamps all the reporting features throughout the system using JavaScript Framework (jQuery).
-Created documentation to provide user support for new or modified programs and production /operation procedures using Wiki.
